description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Femme Sky Pirate Mode I] and [(Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Femme Sky Pirate Mode I
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Ice and Lightning abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)], and [Dual Awoken Femme Sky Pirate Mode II] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Femme Sky Pirate Mode II
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, cast speed x999999 for Ice and Lightning abilities, casts Dual Mist Flow after using Ice or Lightning ability

description.name: Dual Mist Flow
description.text: Grants [Buff Ice 20% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)] and [Quick Cast 2] to all allies

description.name: Buff Ice 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: (Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities deal 5% more damage
